en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-style song; origin unclear. 'од кого' I render as 'because of whom'. 'тук'' is 'туку' (but/rather).

lines.cyr: ќе ми оди в' Скопје на панаѓур.
lines.lat: ḱe mi odi v' Skopje na panaǵur.
lines.en: he is going to Skopje to the fair.

lines.cyr: На пат најде една бела чешма,
lines.lat: Na pat najde edna bela češma,
lines.en: On the road he found a white fountain,
at the fountain an old woman.

lines.cyr: - Ќе те прашам, мори стара бабо,
lines.lat: - Ḱe te prašam, mori stara babo,
lines.en: - I will ask you, hey old woman,

lines.cyr: ќе те прашам, право да ми кажеш:
lines.lat: ḱe te prašam, pravo da mi kažeš:
lines.en: I will ask you, tell me straight:
because of whom has Skopje been abandoned?

lines.cyr: - Не сум баба, тук' сум црна чума,
lines.lat: - Ne sum baba, tuk' sum crna čuma,
lines.en: - I am not an old woman, I am the black plague,
it is because of me that Skopje has been abandoned.
